_notes.name: The name on the poster and above the year.
_notes.year: The year the page opens on, like 2026. The arrows beside it move to the years before it.
_notes.moods: Exactly five moods, from the roughest day to the best. id is lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; label is one to sixteen characters; color is a hex color. The run warns when two colors are too close to tell apart.
_notes.weekStart: mon or sun: the first day of the week in the Stats sheet.
_notes.paper: The poster size: A3, A4, or Letter.
_notes.theme: auto follows the device's light or dark setting; gallery is white with soft tiles; night is black with glowing tiles.
_notes.example: true fills the year up to yesterday with an example year the first time the page opens, so the grid shows what a full year looks like. false starts empty. Once a day is colored, the page keeps what was colored.
